verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI has built-in Logfire instrumentation that generates a trace per agent run with spans for each model request and tool call, viewable in the Logfire observability UI, and Logfire's LLM observability page explicitly describes tracing model calls, tool calls, HTTP requests and DB queries in one trace queryable via SQL. This is well documented with first-party docs and product pages; missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the tracing UI itself (community evidence only mentions using it alongside langfuse, not detailed verification).
